title: VAPID key uses thread_rng not OsRng
description: push.rs:65. SigningKey::random(&mut rand::thread_rng()) generates the long-lived VAPID signing key using thread_rng() instead of OsRng. While rand 0.8 thread_rng is CSPRNG (ChaCha12 seeded from OsRng), the VAPID private key is a persistent server identity key stored in the database. Best practice for long-lived key generation is to use OsRng directly, matching the pattern already used in did.rs:8 and cli.rs:496. The ephemeral key generation at push.rs:347 (EphemeralSecret::random) is also thread_rng but is less concerning since those are per-message ephemeral keys.
close_reason: rand 0.8 thread_rng() is CSPRNG (ChaCha12 seeded from OsRng). No real confidentiality/integrity impact -- style preference only.
